anyOf.description: A buffer plus an optional byte offset into it, e.g. the v slice of a fused qkv buffer.

offset.description: Byte offset added to the base pointer (default `0`), e.g. `4096`.

anyOf.description: A state plus an optional byte offset into it, e.g. one layer's region of a KV cache.

offset.description: Byte offset added to the base pointer (default `0`), e.g. `65536`.

anyOf.description: The current value of a var, e.g. `{"var": "tokens"}`.
The value of a var expression, e.g. `{"expr": {"mul": ["tokens", 32]}}`.
This rank's index in the named topology group, a load-time constant, e.g. `{"rank": "ep"}`.

Bound.description: A domain bound: an integer, a float, or a var expression, e.g. `0`, `1e-6`, `"tokens"`.

domain.description: Optional prior on the contents; the runtime rejects out-of-domain input writes and `kern test` synthesizes values from it.

export.description: Allocate through the driver's virtual-memory API with a fabric-shareable handle so other ranks can map it; the address of every rank's copy lands in the `peer` buffers `of` it. e.g. `true`.

group.description: `peer` buffers only: the topology group the addresses are indexed by, e.g. `"ep"`.

kind.description: Who provides the buffer and how long its contents live.

of.description: `peer` buffers only: the exported buffer or state whose per-rank base addresses this buffer holds, e.g. `"flags"`.

shape.description: Extents, constants or var names, e.g. `["tokens", 2560]`.

BufferKind.description: Who provides a buffer and how long its contents live.

oneOf.description: Written by the runtime before each run, e.g. `token_ids`.
Read back by the runtime after each run, e.g. `next_token`.
Bound by name from the weights file at load time, e.g. `model.embed_tokens.weight`.
Runtime-owned scratch, dead between runs, e.g. `hidden`.
Written by one program and read by another, kept between runs, e.g. the `fc_out` hidden states a draft reads.

`u64[group size]` of device addresses: every group member's copy of the buffer or state named by `of` (`export`ed), this rank's own included. Filled by the runtime once the peers' handles are imported, read-only to ops.

args.description: One argument per interface param, in order.

op.description: Name of the op called, e.g. `"attn"`.

DType.description: Element type of a buffer or scratch, e.g. `"bf16"`.

Dim.description: One shape extent: a constant or a var name, e.g. `2560` or `"tokens"`.

Domain.description: A prior on a buffer's contents: bounds (`{"min": 0, "max": "tokens"}`) or an index into a buffer/state (`{"index_into": "kv", "stride": 16}`).

index_into.description: Buffer or state whose rows / token slots the elements index, e.g. `"model.embed_tokens.weight"`.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, a literal or a var expression, e.g. `"tokens"`.

stride.description: Rows or token slots per index (default `1`), e.g. `16` for a paged KV block table.

Expr.description: A scalar expression: a constant, a var name, `{"ceil_div": [e, c]}` or `{"mul": [e, c]}`, e.g. `{"ceil_div": ["tokens", 128]}`.

args.description: Where each launch param comes from (default: the op's params in order).

params.description: This launch's own ABI when it differs from the op's params.

anyOf.description: The op's interface param: a pointer (with the call's offset) or a scalar.
The current value of a var.
The value of a var expression.
This rank's index in the named topology group.

A 128-byte TMA descriptor over an interface buffer or state, encoded
at load time; sits at a 64-byte aligned offset (a bare `CUtensorMap`
param is a `bytes<128>` with this field at 0, a cute `TiledCopy` has
its dynamic strides after it).

Field.description: One field of a `pack`: a byte offset plus where the value comes from, e.g. `{"at": 8, "var": "tokens"}`.

at.description: Byte offset of the field in the image.

width.description:
Field width in bytes; defaults to the source's own width (8 for a
pointer or i64, 4 for i32 / f32 / var / expr, 1 for u8).

Impl.description: An op implementation: private scratch buffers and one or more launches in order.

args.description: Where each launch param comes from (default: the op's params in order), e.g. `[{"param": 0}, {"scratch": "pmax"}, {"i32": 64}]`.

cluster.description: Thread-block cluster shape, e.g. `[2, 1, 1]`; the grid must be a multiple of it on every axis. Launched with `cuLaunchKernelEx`.

entry.description: Kernel symbol in the module, e.g. `"kern_argmax_partial_bf16"`.

grid.description: Blocks per launch, as expressions, e.g. `[{"ceil_div": ["tokens", 128]}, 1, 1]`.

params.description: This launch's own ABI when it differs from the op's params, e.g. `["in buffer<bf16>", "out buffer<f32>", "i32"]`.

shared_mem.description: Dynamic shared memory in bytes, e.g. `{"mul": ["tokens", 512]}`.

Launch.description: One launch of an implementation: a kernel entry in a pinned module, or a runtime built-in.

anyOf.description: Forward the op's param at this index.
This rank's index in the named topology group, a load-time constant.
An aggregate assembled from fields at byte offsets, for a `bytes<n>` param.

LaunchArg.description: A launch argument: a forwarded op param, a scratch buffer, a literal, or this rank's index in a group, e.g. `{"param": 0}`, `{"scratch": "pmax"}`, `{"i32": 64}`, `{"rank": "ep"}`.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the artifact bytes; the runtime matches modules by this.

source.description: Local file name (`argmax.cubin`) or registry ref (`hf:org/repo/path[@rev]`); a label, not the identity.

Op.description: An operator: the typed interface a call binds, plus the launches that implement it.

impl.description: The implementation; swapping it leaves every call untouched.

params.description: Interface params in call order, e.g. `["out buffer<bf16>", "in buffer<bf16>"]`.

Pack.description:
An aggregate param image, e.g. `{"size": 24, "fields": [{"at": 0, "param": 3}, {"at": 8, "i32": 64}, {"at": 12, "var": "tokens"}]}`:
the bytes a kernel compiled from a struct-taking language (CUTLASS, the CuTe DSL) reads as one parameter.

Bytes no field covers are zero. A pointer field carries the bound buffer's
address (offset honoured), a scalar field its value in the field's width.

fields.description: The fields, each at its byte offset.

size.description: Image size in bytes; equals the `bytes<n>` of the param it binds to.

ParamType.description: One parameter: a scalar (`"i32"`, `"i64"`, `"f32"`, `"u8"`), a directional pointer (`"in buffer<bf16>"`, `"out buffer<f32>"`, `"inout state"`), or a launch-private `"tensormap"` (128-byte TMA descriptor) or `"bytes<n>"` (an n-byte aggregate filled by a `pack` launch arg).

Scratch.description: A private buffer of one implementation, sized like a workspace buffer.

shape.description: Extents, constants or var names, e.g. `["tokens", 8]`.

Spec.description: Speculative-decoding caller contract: `draft` runs over `block` rows per sequence — the anchor token followed by `block - 1` mask tokens; `verify` runs over the anchor and every drafted token. The runtime assigns no meaning to it.

mask_token.description: Token id filling the undrafted rows of `draft`, e.g. `248070`.

State.description: Opaque persistent memory; the runtime provisions the bytes and hands the base pointer to `inout state` params. Exactly one of the three sizes is non-zero. States are always allocated through the driver's virtual-memory API with a fabric-shareable handle when the device has one, so a `peer` buffer may be `of` a state.

bytes.description: Fixed byte count independent of capacity and sequences, e.g. `4096`.

bytes_per_seq.description: Bytes per sequence slot, one slot per live sequence — a recurrent conv/SSM state, e.g. `154140672`. The runtime starts with `seqs.max + 2` slots — slot 0 (never leased; kernels may read line index 0 as null), one per sequence, one for a batched caller's padding — and grows them out of the state budget as checkpoints keep the states of sleeping sequences.

bytes_per_token.description: Bytes per token slot, scaled by the capacity — a paged KV cache, e.g. `147456`.

TensorMap.description:
A tiled TMA descriptor (`cuTensorMapEncodeTiled`) over the buffer bound to interface param `param`, e.g. `{"param": 5, "dtype": "u8", "dims": [3584, 1024], "strides": [3584], "box": [128, 96], "swizzle": 128}`.

`dims` are in elements, innermost first; `strides` are the byte strides of
`dims[1..]`; `box` is the smem tile in elements. Element strides are 1.
The outermost dim may be 0: the descriptor then spans as many of that dim
as the bound buffer holds past the call's offset (a paged cache whose
page count is the runtime's, not the manifest's).

box.description: Box (smem tile) extent per dimension in elements, each 1..=256.

dims.description: Global extent per dimension in elements, innermost first (1 to 5 dims); the outermost may be 0 (span the buffer).

dtype.description: Element type as TMA sees it; `u4` is 16 packed nibbles per 8 bytes (`CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_16U4_ALIGN16B`).

oob_nan.description: Fill out-of-bounds elements with NaN instead of zero.

param.description: The interface buffer param the descriptor addresses (the call's offset is honoured).

strides.description: Byte stride of each dimension after the first (`dims.len() - 1` entries, multiples of 16).

swizzle.description: Shared-memory swizzle span in bytes: 0 (none), 32, 64 or 128.

TmaDType.description: TMA element types the runtime encodes.

oneOf.description: 4-bit elements, 16 per 8-byte unit (`16U4_ALIGN16B`); dims and box count nibbles.

Topology.description: Rank groups, e.g. `{"groups": {"ep": 4}}`. Sizes are fixed in the manifest; the loading rank's index in each group is a load-time constant that `{"rank": "<group>"}` args receive and `peer` buffers are ordered by.

groups.description: Group name to member count, e.g. `{"ep": 4}`.

Var.description: A per-call scalar the caller supplies, bounded `1..=max`; the only kind of number that may size a shape or a grid.

max.description: Upper bound, e.g. `2048` for the token count of a prefill chunk.

description: The whole contract a model ships as: one JSON file naming its vars, states, buffers, modules, ops and programs.

buffers.description: Typed tensors: inputs, outputs, weights, workspace and carries.

modules.description: Code artifacts the launches pin, by name, e.g. `{"argmax": {"source": "argmax.cubin", "sha256": "2537…"}}`.

ops.description: Operators: a typed interface plus the launches that implement it.

spec.description: Speculative-decoding caller contract; absent for plain prefill/decode manifests.

states.description: Opaque persistent memory the runtime provisions by size, e.g. a paged KV cache.

topology.description: Rank groups a multi-GPU manifest is SPMD over, e.g. `{"groups": {"ep": 4}}`; every rank loads the same manifest.

vars.description: Per-call scalars the caller supplies, e.g. `{"tokens": {"max": 2048}}`.
